# Signet7

> Signet7 cryptographically seals email. It does not encrypt mail. Agents verify original message bytes before acting on money-moving instructions.

Akasha is the name on the front door. The company is Signet7.

**Upcoming:** Agent API (signet7-core #315) and MCP package (signet7 #126) are open PRs — not live on production until merge and deploy.

## What Signet7 does

Signet7 answers whether the words in an important email still match a cryptographic seal, and whether the sender is listed. Signet7 seals; it does not encrypt. Submit original RFC 5322 bytes; do not rebuild headers or body.

## Verify (agents, upcoming)

- HTTP: `POST /api/v1/email/verify` with `machine_verdict: true` (or `Accept: application/vnd.signet7.verify.v1+json`) → response includes `verdict_v1` (`signet7.verify.v1` schema).
- MCP (signet7 #126): `pip install "signet7[mcp]"`, console `signet7-mcp`, tools `verify_email`, `seal_email`, `connect`, `status`.
- Verdict fields: `schema`, `sealed`, `verdict` (`sealed`|`unsealed`|`tampered`|`revoked`|`unknown`), `signer_identity` (`sender`, `key_fingerprint`), `delegation` (`agent_label`, `principal`, `agent_token_fingerprint`) or null, `receipt_id`, `checked_at`, `summary`.

## Seal (agents, upcoming)

Agent bearer: `POST /api/v1/email/sign` with `Authorization: Bearer <agent_token>` (scoped). Also requires `X-Signet7-Ack: terms-disclaimer-2026-08-15`. MCP `seal_email` after `connect`.

## Device-code (agents, upcoming)

- `POST /api/v1/agent/device/start` → human approves via account → `POST /api/v1/agent/device/poll` → one-time `agent_token`.
- Human step uses existing `POST /api/v1/account/device/approve` (`session_kind` `agent`).
- `GET /api/v1/agent/status` with bearer agent token (MCP `status`; may 404 until deploy).

## Agent token management (upcoming)

- `POST /api/v1/agent/tokens`, `GET /api/v1/agent/tokens`, `POST /api/v1/agent/tokens/{token_id}/revoke`

## Caller enforces

Refuse consequential actions when `verdict` is not `sealed`. Signet7 returns evidence, not payment approval.

## What is not claimed

No encryption of bodies. Free human check. Not live until the agent PRs deploy.
